title: Missing 'module load oneapi' kills Intel MPI at PMPI_Init_thread within seconds
symptom: Batch job dies ~2 s after start inside OFI provider initialization.
root_cause: The batch script omitted the oneAPI module (e.g. oneapi/2024.2), so Intel MPI initializes with a broken OFI environment.
minimal_fix: Load the oneAPI module in the batch script before the executable; keep the module list part of the pinned execution profile.
avoid: Retrying the same script on a different node to fix an environment bug.
